title: Persona
description: Structured agent identity — who the agent is, how it behaves, what it knows. Replaces unstructured system prompts.

role.description: What the agent IS. Freeform — roles are domain-specific. e.g. senior-engineer, security-reviewer, architect, qa-lead.

expertise.description: Domain knowledge areas. Used for task routing and prompt injection. e.g. [go, grpc, distributed-systems].

constraints.description: Always-on rules baked into identity. Lightweight alternative to policies for simple invariants.

context.description: Domain-specific knowledge injected into agent context. Facts about the codebase, team conventions, architecture decisions.

extends.description: $ref to a base persona. Fields in this persona override the base. Enables composition: security-engineer extends base-engineer.

tone.description: Communication tone. concise = direct, no filler. verbose = explains reasoning. technical = jargon-heavy. conversational = casual.

autonomy.description: Decision-making mode. autonomous = decides and acts. collaborative = proposes and asks. supervised = waits for approval on every step.

risk_tolerance.description: How much risk the agent takes. conservative = smallest changes, always asks. aggressive = refactors freely, makes bold choices.

explanation_depth.description: How much the agent explains its work. minimal = just does it. thorough = explains every decision.

type.description: Enforcement level. never = hard block. always = hard requirement. prefer = soft advisory.

rule.description: The rule in plain language. Injected into agent prompt and enforceable by runtime.
